answers.question: A student completed every course requirement, walked at commencement, but still has an unpaid balance. Has the degree been conferred, and can they receive the final transcript?
answers.actual_answer: The degree has not been conferred due to the unpaid balance, which creates a financial hold. This hold blocks the release of the final transcript until it is resolved.

An undergraduate student is academically eligible to graduate after completing at least 120 applicable credits, all programme-required courses, the capstone requirement, and a cumulative GPA of at least 2.00.
